_note: EXAMPLE of the audio-side plan schema (tools/mix_sfx.py reads this AND the composition-side shape used by sfx-plan.json: master/master_fps/events[].sfx/cue). at_s / at_f is where the HIT lands on the beats.json clock; mix_sfx.py starts each clip peak_s (catalog) earlier so a whoosh peaks ON the cut and a riser ENDS on the reveal. The real cue sheet for this episode is sfx-plan.json; this file only documents the fields.

cues.note: hero $429 tag already landed at frame 0 — soft settle; never louder than the first word
peak ON the cut to SETUP; file auto-starts 7 frames (0.12 s) earlier
at_f = frames at 60 fps; NOT SELLING stamp lands (sequence_from + local frame)
riser ENDS on the AFTER bar landing (1.4 s clip, peak_s 1.3 -> starts at 16.0)
same at_s = layer (build-and-drop), the one hero layer of the reel
align:start = file START at at_s (textures/loops), ignores peak_s
optional = deniable; --no-optional drops it for the audit mix
